name: dracae
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.

attributes.attribute: evil water fairies that lure travelers to drown
lets a person see the dracae
enslaved the captive as a midwife

text: The dracae are evil water fairies in Scottish folklore. They lure travelers by shifting shape into golden objects that float in lakes and rivers. A traveler reaches for the gold cup, but it drifts away. The victim falls into the water and drowns. One captive of the dracae ended up in a beautiful land beneath the waves. There the fairies enslaved her as a midwife. When she finally returned, she touched her eye with Fairy Ointment. That ointment let her see the dracae as they truly were. She perceived them pretending to be normal men and women who walk among us without notice.
